Rower.description: A club member who rows, coxes or coaches. A first name alone is not an identity.

Boat.description: A hull in the club's fleet, known by the name painted on it.

Coaching.description:
A standing link between an athlete and the person who coaches or mentors them.
Coaching one outing does not make someone an athlete's coach.

CrewSeat.description: Which seat a rower takes in a boat's regular crew: stroke, bow or cox.

Outing.description: A session on the water. booked_by reserved the boat, coach runs the session from the bank or launch, sculler is the athlete rowing it. A wish to go out is not a booking.

DamageReport.description: Damage found on a boat. reported_by noticed it, fixer repairs it. repaired stays empty until a repair is recorded.

questions.q: Has the jammed seat track been repaired?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:DamageReport) WHERE n0.damage = 'jammed seat track' RETURN n0.repaired AS repaired

questions.q: Is there a record of the snapped fin being repaired?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:DamageReport) WHERE n0.damage = 'snapped fin' RETURN coalesce(n0.repaired, false) AS repaired

questions.q: Who reported damage to Grey Heron?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Boat)<-[:boat]-(n1:DamageReport)-[:reported_by]->(n2:Rower) WHERE n0.name = 'Grey Heron' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which outings did Ifeoma Adeyemi book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rower)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Outing) WHERE n0.name = 'Ifeoma Adeyemi' RETURN n1.piece AS piece

questions.q: How far is the long paddle?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.piece = 'long paddle' RETURN n0.distance_km AS distance_km

questions.q: What piece and distance were rowed in Saltmarsh?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Boat)<-[:boat]-(n1:Outing) WHERE n0.name = 'Saltmarsh' RETURN n1.piece AS piece, n1.distance_km AS distance_km

questions.q: What distances are the paddle outings?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.piece CONTAINS 'paddle' RETURN n0.distance_km AS distance_km

questions.q: Did the race pace session need the launch?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.piece = 'race pace session' RETURN n0.launch_needed AS launch_needed

questions.q: Is there a record that a launch was needed for the light paddle?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.piece = 'light paddle' RETURN coalesce(n0.launch_needed, false) AS launch_needed

questions.q: What damage did Kalani Akana report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rower)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:DamageReport) WHERE n0.name = 'Kalani Akana' RETURN n1.damage AS damage
